office.text: At CASAGRANDE INGENIERIA we calculate, direct and build. We develop structural solutions for architecture projects, integrating technical analysis, building expertise, and close attention to the construction process.
office.whoWeAreText:
CASAGRANDE INGENIERIA is a civil engineering studio specialized in the development of structural solutions for architecture projects. We participate in the comprehensive development of single-family homes, residential buildings, commercial spaces, and industrial warehouses.
At Casagrande Ingeniería we integrate structural analysis, construction expertise, and close attention to the execution process, working to ensure that each technical decision enhances and strengthens the architectural proposal through an integrated approach, optimized through BIM methodology.
We understand each project as an integral process: we calculate, direct, and build quality works, designed to provide safety, efficiency, and durability over time.
